query:
SELECT 
                u.id as user_profile_id, 
                mui.first_name, 
                mui.last_name,
                EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_agents a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) AS "is_agent!"
            FROM macro_user_info mui
            JOIN "User" u ON mui.macro_user_id = u.macro_user_id
            WHERE u.id = ANY($1)
